verdict.rationale: Mastra is an agent framework with a server and Mastra Cloud deployment, so issuing scoped, least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence documents API key issuance, permission scopes, or per-agent credentials. Guardrails for prompt injection are an adjacent control and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
